patches.message_formatting: Original body indented to protect embedded diff from git mailinfo; CRLF normalized to LF.

historical_matching: Unique normalized subject/filename match, preferring exact matches and first-parent master history; ambiguous matches remain unattributed.
metadata_digest_format: SHA256 of git show -s --format=%an%x00%ae%x00%aI%x00%B output (including final newline)

source_repairs.validation: Native lotusd/lotus-cli/test_lotus build with Chronik OFF; miner_tests and all151 check-bitcoin targets pass. Chronik-enabled integration validation remains separate.
